title: F1 Deferred risk: accepted count attribution limit remains
detail: Released user and normal workflow: an adopter First Officer writes a validation summary using the supplied reports. Observable harm: the wrong unmeasured-cell claim remains unlabelled in candidate runs 2, 3 and 4; the old grader false-passes the base. Boundary: value-ac[AC-8] accepts 3/6 and requires the numeric-source follow-up. Trigger evidence: independently read saved answers, replay-audit.json, semantic-read.json; the current ADR and PR body disclose the limit.
fix: Keep the accepted limit visible; address numeric sourcing in counts-name-the-run-that-produced-them. It becomes Material if delivery claims reliable count correction or hides the limit.
